business_problem: LiblibAI needed stable high-performance infrastructure for large-scale model training, low-cost inference, overseas access, and storage lifecycle management so its AI-creation platform could keep up with user growth and content-generation workloads.
solution_summary: LiblibAI built its AI-creation platform on Baidu AI Cloud using BaiGe heterogeneous compute, Qianfan model tooling, CDN services, and supporting storage architecture. The compute layer is designed for large-scale deep-learning workloads, giving model and operations engineers full lifecycle management, train-infer acceleration, fault tolerance, and intelligent diagnostics. For online text-to-image and related creation services, Baidu provides the large GPU footprint, stable high-throughput networking, and RDMA-compatible training environment required by LiblibAI's platform. The solution also addresses global user distribution: CDN and cross-border acceleration help API requests and user uploads move reliably between overseas users and domestic storage. Meanwhile, tiered storage and archival support keep training datasets and inference workloads economical.

solution_components.name: BaiGe Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud-native AI compute layer for large-scale training, inference acceleration, and cluster operations.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supplies model-development tooling used alongside the compute platform for AI creation services.

solution_components.name: CDN
solution_components.role: Accelerates global API access and cross-border content delivery for overseas users.

data_flow: Model-training jobs and inference requests are scheduled on the BaiGe platform, while user uploads and API traffic are accelerated through CDN and cross-border network paths. Tiered storage holds datasets and archives, and the resulting generated-content services are served back to users through the same elastic infrastructure.
business_outcome: LiblibAI improved compute efficiency and platform availability, optimized cross-border experience for users, and kept storage and serving costs under better control as the creation platform scaled.
architecture_clues: The compute platform supports train-infer acceleration, fault tolerance, intelligent diagnostics, and full task lifecycle management
The design includes RDMA-compatible multi-node multi-GPU training plus tiered and archival storage
Global acceleration is used so users in the US West Coast and Southeast Asia can reach domestic services and upload data reliably
